title: Judges
introduction: Judges records Israel's cycles of disobedience, oppression, deliverance, and relapse in the period before kingship, from the incomplete conquest through the civil war that nearly destroys Benjamin. These twelve studies follow literary divisions; they do not claim twelve independently dated historical events. Archaeology, historical reconstruction, and later interpretation are distinguished from biblical testimony.
